member.summary: One user per string with the following syntax: "username:password". Auth tokens can be specified by appending a colon (:) or bar (|) and a comma separated list of tokens, ex: "username:password:token1, token2, token3" An application specific domain can be appended after another colon or bar, ex: "username:password:tokens:domain". Users with a too long name (over chars) or domain (over chars) are skipped with a warning message, the other users are still loaded. User names are case insensitive (the last definition of a name wins), white spaces around the parts are trimmed, empty lines and lines starting with "#" or "//" are ignored.
